# Baseline releases whose grain contracts this repository is knowingly allowed to differ from.
# One tag per line, then a reason after a space. A waiver applies only while that tag is the baseline, so it
# stops mattering as soon as a later release is cut; delete the line then.
v19.123.0 Job and job step identifiers moved from the Cratis.Orleans to the Cratis.Choreography namespace, which changes the wire identity of IObserver.ReportHandledEvents, ReportHandledEventsBatch and CaughtUp. Settle running jobs before upgrading.
v19.183.3 Kernel grain payloads moved from the JSON codec to generated Orleans serializers, which changes how they are written between silos, and observer and queue grain methods take a shared EventTypeSet instead of an event type list. IObserver.GetDefinition is removed (definitions are read from the event store's observer definition registry) and a per-silo grain service announces definition changes. Observers, the event log, the captures manager and the connected clients registry no longer arm grain timers: a per-silo supervisor runs their duties, which adds IObserver.CheckHealth and VerifyLiveSubscriptionAfterDeparture, IEventSequence.ReconcileSubscriptions, ICapturesManager.Reconcile and IConnectedClients.Revise. Stop all nodes, then start the new version.
v19.183.4 Client reactors and reducers are no longer grains: the Reactor, Reducer and ReducersManager grains and their interfaces are removed, and the kernel serves client subscriptions from plain per-silo subscription objects. IObserver methods that took an event type list now take an EventTypeSet, and the subscribe, restore, reconcile, recover and replay-partition calls that carried a client subscriber are removed. IAppendedEventsQueue and IAppendedEventsQueues subscribe with an EventTypeSet, IProjectionsManager.RegisterShared changed signature, ICapturesManager gained Reconcile, and IEventSequence.Append, IImport.Get and ISystem.GetVersion changed their nullability. Stop all nodes, then start the new version.
